sections.overview: This small African fish belongs to the family Distichodontidae.
sections.identification: A French FAO key separates it from Nannocharax procatopus by its higher lateral-line scale count, 40–42+3–4.
sections.habitat: It occurs in the Congo, Okavango and Kafue river systems.
sections.diet: It picks small insects and other invertebrates from riverbank plants.
sections.behavior: It occurs in flowing water among marginal vegetation.
sections.reproduction: Species-specific spawning and parental care remain undocumented in the sources consulted.
sections.ecology: Some upper Zambezi and Kafue records were reassigned to the relative Nannocharax dageti.
sections.conservation: The IUCN assessment relayed by FishBase is Least Concern, dated 2009.
